answer: The highways authority grants one toll-bridge concession per bridge, after tender, survey and background check, listed in an open register. The bridge spans a tidal inlet used by orchard growers, tolls logged daily and audited. Each costs a 4,000-unit bond plus 1,200 units a year in upkeep, and 180 days from tender to opening; one bridge backs one identity, a second claim is refused. One hundred fakes cost 520,000 units and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat is renting one: the lender loses its toll income and its own anchor, and a forged inspection certificate fails the register check.
